Jordan Rivera
jordan.rivera@example.com · +1 415 555 0142 · Oakland, CA, USA

Dear Acme Ledger Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Lead Software Engineer, Frontend (React) role at Acme Ledger. My background combines frontend architecture for a payments product used by 2 million customers with hands-on React and TypeScript delivery. At Brightline Payments, I am a Senior Software Engineer and tech lead for a squad of 5 engineers, with responsibility for the frontend platform roadmap, design reviews, and code reviews. This combination connects closely to the hands-on leadership described in your posting.

I led the merchant dashboard migration from Angular to React and TypeScript, cutting p95 page load from 4.1s to 1.6s and reducing frontend incidents by 60% over the following year. I also built a Playwright end-to-end suite with 220 checkout scenarios and integrated it into GitHub Actions, replacing manual QA with a 25-minute automated gate. Alongside that delivery work, I mentored 4 engineers, two of whom were promoted to senior, and introduced weekly architecture reviews that reduced rework on large features by about a third.

Your plan to rebuild the front end for the next decade makes the role especially relevant to my experience modernizing a merchant dashboard while improving its performance. The emphasis on accessibility also connects to my work maintaining react-form-kit, an open-source collection of accessible React form primitives used by 3 companies in production. I would bring that practical perspective to discussions about the platform's next stage, drawing on both product delivery and reusable frontend components.

Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome a conversation about how my frontend architecture, delivery, and mentoring experience could contribute to your team.

Sincerely,
Jordan Rivera

# Jordan Rivera

## Summary
Senior software engineer with nine years building web platforms, including frontend architecture for a payments product used by 2 million customers. Tech lead for a squad of 5 engineers, with React and TypeScript delivery, performance improvements, and mentoring experience.

## Skills
- **Frontend:** React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Next.js
- **Leadership:** Technical Leadership, Mentoring
- **Delivery:** CI/CD, Playwright, Performance Optimization
- **Platform:** GraphQL, AWS, Node.js

## Experience
### Senior Software Engineer — Brightline Payments
San Francisco, CA (remote) · Mar 2022 – Present
Tech lead for a squad of 5 engineers since 2024; own the frontend platform roadmap and run design reviews and code reviews.
- Led the merchant dashboard migration from Angular to React and TypeScript, cutting p95 page load from 4.1s to 1.6s.
- Reduced frontend incidents by 60% over the year following the dashboard migration.
- Mentored 4 engineers, two promoted to senior; introduced weekly architecture reviews that cut rework on large features by about a third.
- Built Playwright end-to-end testing for checkout: 220 scenarios integrated into GitHub Actions with a 25-minute automated release gate.
- Designed and shipped a React checkout SDK, 38 KB gzipped, adopted by 1,200 merchants in its first six months and processing $410M annually.

Seattle, WA · Jun 2017 – Feb 2022
Full-stack engineer on the patient scheduling product; owned the appointment API and its React front end.

## Education
- B.S. in Computer Science, University of Washington, 2017

## Certifications
- AWS Certified Developer – Associate, Amazon Web Services, 2023 (valid through May 2029)

## Projects
- **react-form-kit — Maintainer:** Open-source accessible form primitives built with React and TypeScript; accessibility work used by 3 companies in production, with 1.9k GitHub stars.
